```yaml
name: Benchmark v2 set

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      task_count:
        description: 'Number of top reward tasks to run (1‑10)'
        required: true
        default: 2
        type: number
      agent:
        description: 'Agent type'
        required: true
        default: default
        type: string
      provider:
        description: 'Provider'
        required: true
        default: openai
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model name'
        required: true
        default: gpt-4o-mini
        type: string
      timeout:
        description: 'Timeout in minutes'
        required: true
        default: 30
        type: number

jobs:
  select_tasks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      task_ids: ${{ steps.select.outputs.task_ids }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Select tasks
        id: select
        run: |
          COUNT=${{ github.event.inputs.task_count }}
          TASK_IDS=$(jq -c ".[0:$COUNT]" data/v2-top-reward-tasks.json)
          echo "task_ids=$TASK_IDS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

  benchmark:
    needs: select_tasks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: ${{ github.event.inputs.timeout }}
    env:
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        task_id: ${{ fromJSON(needs.select_tasks.outputs.task_ids) }}
      max-parallel: 1
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          bun run benchmark-v2 \
            --task-id ${{ matrix.task_id }} \
            --agent ${{ github.event.inputs.agent }} \
            --provider ${{ github.event.inputs.provider }} \
            --model ${{ github.event.inputs.model }} \
            --timeout ${{ github.event.inputs.timeout }}
        shell: bash
```
